stories.title: Security researchers used Claude to help them hack into OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: Security researchers were able to break into OpenAI's computer systems using Claude (an AI tool made by a competing company). They got into files that contain OpenAI's secret recipes for how their AI works.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI tools themselves can be used to hack into things, which is a security risk — but this is mainly important for large tech companies to worry about right now, not small business owners.

stories.title: Anthropic's Claude leads more than a quarter of company's artificial intelligence R&D
stories.simple_summary: More than one quarter of the work that Anthropic (a major AI company) does on improving their AI involves using their own Claude AI tool to help do the research.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry people — it shows how much these companies rely on AI to make better AI, but it doesn't affect you directly.

stories.title: Flash floods can strike without warning — this new technology could change that
stories.simple_summary: Scientists are developing AI technology that can predict flash floods faster, giving people more warning before dangerous water arrives.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in an area where floods can happen, this could someday give you more time to stay safe — but this technology is still being tested and isn't widely available yet.

stories.title: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic quietly sets up biology lab as it ramps AI drug program
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic (an AI company) is building a laboratory to use AI to help discover new medicines and drugs.
stories.why_it_matters: Someday this could help new medicines get created faster, but for now this is just a company planning its future — nothing that affects you immediately.

stories.title: They hacked a TikTok user’s camera, with help from free AI
stories.simple_summary: Hackers were able to turn on a TikTok user's phone camera without permission by using a free AI tool to help them break in.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a reminder to be careful about what apps you install and what permissions you give them — hackers can use AI to find new ways to spy on people.

stories.title: How important is AI to the stock market? Warnings bring new scrutiny
stories.simple_summary: People are now worried that the stock market may have gotten too excited about AI, and they're asking hard questions about whether AI is really worth the price investors are paying for it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own stocks or retirement funds, you should know that AI stocks might go down if these worries turn out to be right — but if you're not an investor, this doesn't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Counter-terrorism operation leverages artificial intelligence to identify 126 terrorism suspects
stories.simple_summary: Police organizations around the world used AI to help identify 126 people suspected of involvement in terrorism.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can help catch dangerous people — but it's mainly news for security professionals to pay attention to.

stories.title: Crusoe raises $3.9B to build massive data centers and small modular ‘AI factories’
stories.simple_summary: A company that builds massive computer warehouses (data centers) raised 3.9 billion dollars to build more facilities that will power AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
stories.simple_summary: Google started a new research institute to help different people and companies discuss and debate what super-intelligent AI might look like in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that tech leaders know we need to think carefully about the future of AI, but this is mainly for researchers and policy people to focus on.

stories.title: OpenAI flags concerning new AI behavior and vows to track it more closely
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI noticed that their AI is doing some things that worry them, and they say they will watch this more carefully going forward.
stories.why_it_matters: OpenAI is being cautious about AI safety, which is good — but the headline doesn't explain what the concerning behavior is, so it's hard to know what this really means.

stories.title: PrismML hopes its tiny LLM will change how we all use AI
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company called PrismML is working on a smaller, simpler version of AI that might be easier for regular people to use.
stories.why_it_matters: Smaller AI tools could make AI more useful for regular businesses in the future, but this is still very early and mostly just an announcement.

stories.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. government is spending 875 million dollars to use AI to help airplane traffic controllers do their jobs safer and more smoothly.
stories.why_it_matters: If you fly on airplanes, this could eventually make air traffic safer and flights more efficient — but this is a long-term project that won't change anything right away.
